title: SmimeError lacks PartialEq/Eq — pattern-matching in tests requires workarounds
description: error.rs: SmimeError derives Debug and Clone but not PartialEq or Eq. The Der variant wraps der::Error, which may not implement PartialEq — but all other variants are strings, unit variants, or Vec<SignerResult>. Callers writing tests to assert on specific error variants must use matches!() patterns rather than assert_eq!(), and cannot easily assert on error message content. This generates repeated workarounds in test code. The AllSignersFailed(Vec<SignerResult>) variant is fully derivable since SignerResult is PartialEq. Scenario: any future test file that checks for specific error conditions.
close_reason: Fixed: added PartialEq to SmimeError derive (der::Error implements PartialEq)
